tools.label: IG Login (main tool)
tools.desc: Single account login — per-device fingerprint, proxy/country support, 2FA TOTP auto-complete (2026 CAA flow)

fields.name: totp
fields.label: TOTP Secret (2FA)
fields.help: Authenticator app ki base32 secret key. 2FA wale accounts ke liye zaroori — code panel khud banayega.

fields.name: country
fields.label: Country
fields.help: AUTO = proxy URL se country auto-detect (IPRoyal _country-XX / DataImpulse cr.xx); bina proxy = IN. Explicit chunna ho to account ki country — proxy exit se match honi chahiye.

fields.name: proxy
fields.label: Proxy (optional)
fields.help: Khali chhoda to apni direct IP se chalega. STICKY zaroori hai: DataImpulse gw.dataimpulse.com ports 10000-20000 (sessid username me), ya old IPRoyal gateway geo.iproyal.com:12321 (_country-in_session-X_lifetime-30m). Rotating (port 823) se 429 aata hai.

fields.name: web
fields.label: Web cookies bhi lao (csrftoken wagera)
fields.help: Default OFF. Sirf tab ON karo jab session web-automation me use karni ho.

fields.name: force
fields.label: Force (cooldown lock ignore — recommended NAHI)
fields.help: GENERIC_ERROR ke baad 12h, FALLBACK ke baad 1h, 429 ke baad 45min ka auto-lock lagta hai. Force = lock bypass (sirf ek attempt).

fields.name: app_profile
fields.label: App Profile (version identity)
fields.help: 449 = DEFAULT (consistent identity: templates ka bloks hash 449 ka, instagrapi + instagram-cli Oct 2026 bhi 449 chalate hain, Pixel 8 Pro Android 14 device auto-apply). 451 = experimental (inconsistent hash). 448 = purana.

fields.name: tls
fields.label: TLS engine
fields.help: auto = uTLS (curl_cffi) agar installed — RECOMMENDED. Proxy pe send_login 429-0B aaye to: pip install "curl_cffi>=0.15.0"
